description: A gray T-shirt lies on a light wooden tabletop in front of you, with a brown fabric backdrop behind it. The left hand reaches forward to grab and lift the shirt, then the right hand comes in to help spread it open into a two-hand object before both hands lay it flat; the left hand folds one side inward lengthwise, then both hands align the edges and fold the long rectangle in half into a compact stack and release it.
